# Rural Utility Cost Calculator
> Free tools and calculators for rural living, property development, and farm management.

This site provides calculators to estimate costs for:
- Property & Construction (Land value, Septic, Fencing, Well drilling, etc.)
- Energy & Utilities (Generators, Solar, Internet, Cable, Propane)
- Animal & Farm (Input costs, Livestock, Gestation, Meat Yield, Honey, etc.)
- Business & Profit (Pain point priority, Cut cost, Processing compliance)
- Farm Finance & Loans (Loan payment, Equipment payment, Land affordability)

All calculators are interactive client-side tools built with React.

## Navigation
- Home: /
- Calculators: available via navigation menu or search on the homepage
- Articles & Guides: /articles
